retention_decision: Reject: aggregate RSS is higher in all six paired deployments across both unchanged-workload controls (median ratios 1.069 and 1.014). First-control CPU improves in every pair; confirmation CPU improves in two pairs. These CPU gains do not justify the consistent RSS regression for the stated CPU-and-memory efficiency objective. Restore original product merger and remove consuming APIs; retain the complete semantic regression and all measured controls.
